core_obligations: Cite the base change lemma so only pseudo-coherence of K remains; set up the strategy of approximating E by perfect complexes and reduce to showing K is m-pseudo-coherent for every m (proof lines 7689-7704).

Localize S affine, note X is quasi-compact quasi-separated, pick the cohomological dimension N of Rf_* from the quasi-coherence lemma and a bound b with G^i = 0 for i > b; choose the perfect approximation P -> E of (X, E, m - N - 1 - b) via the approximation theorem and extend to the distinguished triangle P -> E -> C -> P[1] (proof lines 7696-7710).

Degree chase: cohomology of C vanishes in degrees >= m - N - 1 - b, so after tensoring with G^bullet it vanishes in degrees >= m - N - 1, and after Rf_* in degrees >= m - 1; hence Rf_*(P tensor G) -> Rf_*(E tensor G) is an isomorphism on cohomology in degrees >= m (proof lines 7711-7722).

Cut off the bounded above tail: with H^i(P) = 0 for i > a, the smart truncation sigma_{>= m - N - 1 - a} G^bullet gives an isomorphism on cohomology in degrees >= m after Rf_*; by the perfect-case lemma the source is perfect, so K agrees in degrees >= m with a perfect object and is m-pseudo-coherent (proof lines 7723-7738).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to m-pseudo-coherence of K for every m (proof lines 7689-7704).
Approximate E by a perfect complex P using the cohomological dimension N and the bound b (proof lines 7696-7710).
Chase degrees to compare Rf_*(P tensor G) with K in high degrees (proof lines 7711-7722).
Truncate the tail of G^bullet, invoke the perfect-case lemma, and conclude m-pseudo-coherence (proof lines 7723-7738).
